<!-- pr-reviewer: 97e6140baece5724237ea9be2af2f7c49b779b00 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The two STEP files now have expected results and separate tests. The file list check and all tolerances stay the same. This change meets issue #1799. The decision record explains why the optional gate mapping is separate work.

Local checks against upstream/main a39e9a8b42cca07a1ef098a932e71aab02a4b8ee:
- The trial merge was clean. Main is already in the PR branch.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selected the full step_agreement suite.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --release --test step_agreement`: build passed; 17 tests passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-kernel --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

No production geometry, posted G-code, collision checks, or stock simulation changed. No golden files moved. No UI files changed. Mutation checks were not run in this review: this is a test-only change. The two new tests passed with the stated expected results.

Requested before merge: none.

Note: crates/kernel/tests/step_agreement.rs now has 454 lines. This is above the approximate 400-line limit. This small addition to the existing table does not block this fix.

Cargo reported future Rust compatibility warnings for the existing nom 3.2.1 and quick-xml 0.22.0 dependencies.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
